newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Telkom says bonds issue unlikely in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Telkom says bonds issue unlikely in 1997.

text.p: Indonesia's telecommunications giant PT Telekomunikasi Indonesia said on Monday it had received proposals from foreign investment bankers for a bond issue but said an issue was unlikely this year.

"Yes, we have received proposals for a bond issuance from several foreign investment bankers," Telkom finance director Harry Supangkat told reporters after briefing analysts at a meeting organised by PT ING Baring Securities Indonesia.
"I don't think we should issue bonds this year as we still have the remaining IPO proceeds, but we certainly are considering the possibility," Supangkat told reporters.
He declined to give details on the remaining proceeds from the firm's initial public offering in October 1995.
The state-controlled Telkom is also listed in New York and in London.
